_about: Which NHS trusts go on which FOI Health map layer, from the team's list (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pF65apVm7cCWDzT0PdlfXY1KQGA6x5ciSSjZq38uN_Q). Names are matched to current trusts in NHS ODS, including former names of merged trusts; 'renamed' maps names ODS no longer knows to today's trust code. Trusts on no list are grouped by type. Edit this file to move a trust between layers. 'mental_health_councils' corrects the council-to-trust rule where needed (e.g. Stoke-on-Trent).
